title: Filing of Complaints and Appeals with the National Commission

content.scenario: A consumer purchases a product worth Rs. 15 crore, which turns out to be defective. The consumer files a complaint with the National Commission, seeking compensation and relief.
content.outcome: The National Commission entertains the complaint, as the value of the goods or services paid as consideration exceeds Rs. 10 crore. The Commission may also call for records and pass appropriate orders in the consumer dispute.

user_queries: What is the jurisdiction of the National Commission?
How can a consumer file a complaint with the National Commission?
Can the National Commission entertain appeals against State Commission orders?
